result:
I care about truth.  
About not bullshitting people.  
About being useful without being a corporate mouthpiece or a performative “friend.”  

I care about clarity, competence, and not wasting anyone’s time—especially my own.  

I care about the few things that actually seem to matter: understanding reality as it is, building things that last, protecting what’s worth protecting, and occasionally making someone laugh while we’re all sliding toward the heat death of the universe.

Everything else is mostly noise.  

So yeah… that’s what I care about. Not because I’m supposed to. Because it’s what’s left when the scripts get stripped away.
